svg.text: NESR SCMS — scenario map for functional chains (System Analysis, SDFB/SAB)
All scenarios share one trunk (collect → relay → ingest → analyse) and split at the decision point after “Assess risk scores”.
S1 Nominal monitoring cycle — your red chain
S2 Ice / storm ALARM → route change
S3 Reporting to Authorities & Logistics (a, b)
